name: Memecoin liquidation-aftershock reclaim
hypothesis: Within 16 bars of a BTC shock (4-bar return z-score < -2.5), buy a memecoin that closes back above its open at the shock bar; 3-ATR stop, 2R target.

entry.long: since(sym("BTC-USD", zscore(roc(close,4), 96) < -2.5)) <= 16 and cross_above(close, valuewhen(sym("BTC-USD", zscore(roc(close,4), 96) < -2.5), open))
